# Field Glasses

The same gear kit in English: the picture, the contents, the trait and
the story points under the `en` captions. The deck prints `de` and
leaves it out. Invented for this deck.

```cardsmith
card:
  system: troubleshooters
  card-type: gear
  language: en
data:
  name: Field Glasses
  image: "[[Feldstecher.png]]"
  content: 8×30 binoculars in a leather case, strap, cleaning cloth
  traits:
    - name: Observation
      desc: +2 pips at long range
  story-points: 1
  reference: Rulebook p. 131
```
